entries.mechanism: The 2026 pipeline reports 703.56; TAXSIM 2024 reports 552.97, a 150.59-dollar gap. TAXSIM's 2024 Nebraska siitax is the 2024 before-credit tax (718.97, applying the un-indexed 2024 brackets and the 2.46/3.51/5.01/ 5.84 per cent 2024 rates over the smaller 2024 standard deduction) less the 166-dollar 2024 section 77-2716.01 personal exemption credit: 718.97 - 166 = 552.97, reproducing TAXSIM exactly. The residual is the 2024-to-2026 rate-compression and indexation vintage (703.56 - 718.97 = -15.41) plus the 166-dollar exemption credit the before-credits core excludes. Not a pipeline defect; the pipeline matches PolicyEngine at 2026 exactly.
